verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents routing events to a catalog of 200+ destinations. Its Transformations feature lets you filter, enrich and reshape events before they reach destinations, and a community user reports it 'just works' as one place to send analytics data. The evidence does not show that mapping and filtering can be configured per destination, and no destination integration docs are cited. Missing for 10: explicit per-destination field mapping and filtering configuration, documented per-destination integration pages, independent hands-on corroboration of mapping and filtering behaviour.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can route events to a large catalog of documented destination integrations with per-destination mapping and filtering

citations.quote: Send your events to 200+ third-party tools and platforms
Transformations let you filter, enrich, and reshape event data before it reaches your destinations.
Instrument one RudderStack SDK and automatically send standardized data to hundreds of destinations
one place to send all our analytics data across our various platforms and it just works
